title: ID0453780-DC/Si-D/CZ- [MP / R3 170001597] Error flags on the charger
description:
Reported behavior/issue: We see these error flags on the charger:
PowerConverter[0] PLC DEVICE true
2102312VGQLUNA000275SA012200000204FW:DC116PF116H100,F:1
false
PowerConverter[9] PLC DEVICE true
2102312VGQLUNA000763SA042200000204FW:DC116PF116H100,F:1
false
These flags are not self-recoverable. They apparat again and again
after hard reboot.
Thank you for checking.

additional_info.subject: RE: ID0453780-DC/Si-D/CZ- [MP / R3 170001597] Error flags on the charger CRM:02832000540
additional_info.body:
Dear Milan,
The power converter 0 and 9 were not able to be updated on the last update and because of that, they are not able to provide power at the moment.
Although the charger works well, is just not able to provide full power.
It is expected that with the new firmware version, the will be solved. The new firmware is planned for beggining of november.
As an alternative you can replace the power converters.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team - Laura Martins,
Please do not change the subject of this email when replying to it.

additional_info.subject: RE: ID0453780-DC/Si-D/CZ- [MP / R3 170001597] Error flags on the charger CRM:02832000540
additional_info.body:
Hello Laura,
After an on-site visit on Tuesday, 07.10. We found the following behaviour.
We power cycled the charger, but the fault on converter 2102312VGQLUNA000275SA012200000204FW prevailed.
Therefore, we replaced TB15 (2102312VGQLUNA000275SA012200000204FW) with adjacent TB14. Fault on TB15 prevailed, so the issue is not in the connection.
Are you sure that the new FW coming in November will be able to mitigate this problem? If yes, we would give it a try before replacing the converter.
Kind regards,
Milan

additional_info.subject: RE: ID0453780-DC/Si-D/CZ- [MP / R3 170001597] Error flags on the charger CRM:02832000540
additional_info.body:
Dear Milan,
There was a mistake on my side, the new firmware will not solve this issue. My apologies.
We have tested again the converter grouping on this charger and it is not possible to communicate with the converter
2102312VGQLUNA000275SA012200000204FW.
With the tests from your side and the grouping failing, it shows it is necessary to
replace the converter
2102312VGQLUNA000275SA012200000204FW.
I will send this ticket to your queue, for the converter replacement.
I'm sorry for the misunderstanding, and let me know if you have any other questions.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team - Laura Martins,
Please do not change the subject of this email when replying to it.
